response.outreach_email:
Subject: Fellow Fictional Advisory Partners alum exploring PM

Hi Daniel,

I'm Priya, an MBA candidate (Class of 2028) and a former Senior Consultant at Fictional Advisory Partners, where I led digital transformation projects for retail clients. I'm working to move from consulting into product management at a B2B software company. Your path from Fictional Advisory Partners to leading the analytics product group at Northwind Software stood out to me.

Would you be open to a 20-minute call in the coming weeks? I'd love to hear how you made the jump into PM and which skills you had to build first.

Thanks for considering it,
Priya Nair

tmay_2min.text: Thank you for making the time to talk with me today, Daniel.
I've been looking forward to it.

I'm Priya, and I'm an MBA candidate in the Class of 2028. I earned my B.S. in Information Systems in 2021, and from 2021 to 2026 I was a Senior Consultant at Fictional Advisory Partners. There, I led four digital transformation projects for retail clients.
What I found myself drawn to most was the data side of the work.
I love turning messy data into tools people actually use.
My favorite example is a pricing dashboard I built that ended up being used by 30 store managers. They kept asking for more features,
which told me it was solving a real problem for them. I realized I wanted to be the one deciding what to build next, rather than handing it off at the end of a project.
That's why I'm moving from consulting into product management. I'm targeting Product Manager roles at B2B software companies, and my goal is to own a product end to end.
I'm excited about that next chapter, and I'm also very aware that I still have a lot to learn.
That's a big part of why I wanted to talk with you.
We both worked at Fictional Advisory Partners, in different years, and you went on to join Northwind Software as a PM and now lead the analytics product group.
